select from sys_menu where tenant_id in (0, #{tenantId}) and deleted = 0 order by parent_id asc, sort_order asc, id asc

select distinct m.id, m.tenant_id, m.parent_id, m.resource_type, m.resource_code, m.resource_name, m.route_path, m.api_path, m.http_method, m.sort_order, m.visible, m.status, m.created_at, m.updated_at, m.deleted from sys_menu m inner join sys_role_permission rp on rp.resource_id = m.id and rp.tenant_id = #{tenantId} inner join sys_user_role ur on ur.role_id = rp.role_id and ur.tenant_id = #{tenantId} where ur.user_id = #{userId} and m.tenant_id in (0, #{tenantId}) and m.deleted = 0 and m.status = 'ENABLED' order by m.parent_id asc, m.sort_order asc, m.id asc
